description.narrative:
The Central Labour Advisory Council (CLAC), the highest formal tripartite mechanism established a tripartite (technical) committee with representation from relevant line ministries under the leadership of Ministry of Labour Employment and Social Security (MoLESS) on 09 March 2022 to publicize and implement recommendations from the Diagnostic report on extent, circumstances, causes, factors and nature of informality in Nepal (diagnostic). In the recommendation of the tripartite committee, MoLESS validated the joint MoLESS-ILO Diagnostic report with formal communication sent on 08 April 2022.
The tripartite committee members developed an action plan on formalization for 6 months (August to February 2022), which was further recommended to CLAC through the committee. The Action Plan was approved by CLAC on 15 July 2022. The Action Plan implementation progress was reviewed by the committee and necessary revisions recommended to CLAC, which was also duly approved on 06 July 2023. Revisions included: i. Extension of timeline from February 2023 to July 2024. ii. Tripartite committee's responsibility revalidation for implementation and with timeline extension till July 2024.
Formalisation is mainstreamed into MoLESS 5-year strategy, under Strategy 3.9 on the Gradual Transition to Formal Employment, which proposes clarifying the legal definition of informality, supporting training and awareness at all levels of Government, and reforming social security schemes to allow the participation of informal sector workers. ILO provided technical support to the Ministry of Labour Employment and Social Security and to social partners to: i. Develop and publish the Diagnostic report on extent, circumstances, causes, factors, and nature of informality in Nepal, with support from the Government of Japan. ii. Drafting national action plan on formalization and supporting its implementation as a member of the tripartite committee on formalization. iii. Drafting of the revised national action plan on formalization as a member of the tripartite committee on formalization.
